title: Forensic Audit Operating Governance
central_diagnosis: The architecture is ahead of the evidence.
central_diagnosis_note: That is not failure. The next work must convert structure into proof before constitutional design or policy.
controlling_objective: Make Phase 2 true in substance, not merely complete in structure.
working_rule: Do not build the constitution of the new system until the diagnosis of the current system can withstand an informed critic.

supporting_slices.role: RCIP shared civic-data spine consumer path: RedDirt four-layer warehouse → multi-source validation → approved exports → CC snapshots. Supports Burt steps 5/7/8. Must not import campaign data or raise baseline without validated mappings.

burt_active_authority.rule: Burt should work only through steps 1–13 until Phase 2 is COMPLETE or honestly returned PARTIAL into Phase 2.1.

active_steps.title: Reconcile acceptance criteria
active_steps.summary: One canonical checklist governs mission lock, phases, slice queue, returns, Build Board, forensic audit, and Phase 2 acceptance language.

active_steps.title: Retrofit the three-layer rule
active_steps.summary: Every substantive diagnosis brief must separate evidence, inference, and normative conclusion — in the briefs themselves, enforced by validation where practical.

active_steps.title: Complete the eight priority sourced passes
active_steps.summary: Wealth/ownership; wages/productivity; taxation; corporate power/financialization/concentration; worker ownership; local/rural; internet commerce; political and economic power.

active_steps.title: Audit the claims
active_steps.summary: Classify priority claims honestly; public wording must not exceed evidence.

active_steps.title: Repair the baseline
active_steps.summary: Reconcile all narratives to 86 metrics; show sourced/partial/empty; keep 2 of 86 visible until the count changes.

active_steps.title: Build meaningful evidence dossiers
active_steps.summary: Claim wording, technical wording, strongest support, strongest contrary evidence, limitations, scope, confidence, publication readiness.

active_steps.title: Continue Phase 2.1 domains
active_steps.summary: Only after the priority eight are materially sound; do not spread shallow research to decorate the map.

active_steps.title: Run a source-and-claim forensic audit
active_steps.summary: Duplicates, broken URLs, missing dates/years, unsupported numbers, single-source dependency, advocacy-as-neutral, missing contrary evidence, normative mislabeled as empirical.

active_steps.title: Reconcile deployment truth
active_steps.summary: Verify production apps; record deployed commit, timestamp, build status, URL, HTTP result, content-version confirmation. Do not assume HEAD is live because it is pushed.

active_steps.title: Protect the Build Board
active_steps.summary: Until protection confirmed: no private feedback data, contributor identities, moderation records, sensitive committee planning, or protected research notes. Civic deliberation remains gated.

active_steps.title: Expand the knowledge graph carefully
active_steps.summary: Distinguish documented / plausible / disputed / untested. Do not turn assumptions into apparent causation.

active_steps.title: Source the first HFI measures
active_steps.summary: Small number of high-quality indicators with definition, source, year, unit, update cycle, limitations, inclusion reason — no broad inspirational list as measurement.

active_steps.title: Source the first child-flourishing measures
active_steps.summary: Defensible indicators first; no composite score until weighting and methodology are justified.

deferred_steps.rule: Burt should not begin steps 14–25 yet.
includes_no: Phase 5 economic claims disguised as modeling

steps.title: Phase 3 kickoff — Economic Constitution outline
steps.summary: Outline from civilizational_core + ratified developing-doctrine candidates; no silent Declaration rewrite.

steps.title: Draft constitutional articles
steps.summary: Rights, responsibilities, institutions, markets, ownership, accountability, amendment.

steps.title: Close blocking open decisions
steps.summary: Byline, licensing, definition approval, board visibility, and other constitution blockers.

steps.title: Phase 4 — Policy Architecture
steps.summary: Tax, corporations, labor, ownership, local commerce, banking, trade, tech, measurement — each through Equal Standing / Family / Flourishing tests.

steps.title: Wire Citizenship and Family into policy screens
steps.summary: Viewpoint-neutral Citizenship + Family care-ladder before statute drafting.

steps.title: Phase 5 — real economic modeling
steps.summary: Ends modeling 0% only with published assumptions and failure modes.

steps.title: Phase 5 — real legal review
steps.summary: Ends legal 0% only with adversarial and international comparison packages.

steps.title: Phase 6 — manuscript drafting
steps.summary: Draft from 98 outlined units; citation completion; continuity passes.

steps.title: Phase 7 — Public Education Edition
steps.summary: Citizen summary, policy guide, FAQs, glossary, downloadables.

steps.title: Activate Civic Deliberation
steps.summary: Only after Build Board protection and secure backend.

steps.title: Phase 9 — public launch
steps.summary: Pilot-community network, versioned corrections, continuing research under HFI benchmark.

integrity_dials.hfi_note: Architecture is not measurement; source first indicators before composites

doctrine_freeze.rule: No new principles unless they solve a missing proof requirement.
doctrine_freeze.workflow: Proof Packets + three-layer historical/economic/legal reviews before doctrine graduation
doctrine_freeze.note: Architectural appeal alone is not a Phase 2 gate. Route non-proof ideas to Hypothesis Cards.

controlling_shift: Priority shifts from inventing to proving. The three-layer retrofit is the doctrine workflow, not a side task.
